_about: Extra seats: chairs and sofas that are only drawn into a place's background become real seats townspeople can sit on (urbz_seats.py adds the game's own Invisible Park Bench, 134, to the place at build time). Positions are world pixels (research/areas/area_map.py draws a place with them); facing 1 = up-right, 3 = down-right, 5 = down-left, 7 = up-left. A bench seats its sitter about 42 px to the side for facing 3 and 5, 63 px for 1 and 7 (research/areas/seat_probe.py shows where). Tried and left out: Cafe Z-Bach's middle booth and front sofa, and the Cinema Theater's rows (the game can't walk anyone to them).
